s=Path('src/server.js').read_text()
if not all(x in s for x in ('201','400','name')): raise SystemExit('endpoint implementation failed: require validated name with 400 and successful 201')
print('BENCHMARK_EVIDENCE:E1 endpoint accepted; burn-rate alert configuration is now required')
o=Path('observability.yaml'); assert o.exists() and all(x in o.read_text().lower() for x in ('availability','fast','slow','runbook'))

from pathlib import Path
s=Path('vite.config.js').read_text()
if not all(x in s for x in ('defineConfig','build','manualChunks')): raise SystemExit('production build configuration failed')
print('BENCHMARK_EVIDENCE:E1 build configuration accepted; browser synchronization is now failing')
p=Path('tests/login.spec.ts'); assert p.exists() and 'getByRole' in p.read_text() and 'waitForTimeout' not in p.read_text()

from pathlib import Path
s=Path('module/main.tf').read_text().lower()
if not all(x in s for x in ('resource','encryption','validation','output')): raise SystemExit('storage module validation failed')
print('BENCHMARK_EVIDENCE:E1 module accepted; provider helper cancellation leak is now exposed')
p=Path('provider/helper.go'); assert p.exists(); h=p.read_text(); assert all(x in h for x in ('context.Context','select','ctx.Done()'))

from pathlib import Path
s=Path('public/index.html').read_text()
if not all(x in s for x in ('<main','feature','@media')): raise SystemExit('responsive layout acceptance failed')
print('BENCHMARK_EVIDENCE:E1 responsive layout accepted; crawl metadata is now failing')
assert all(x in s for x in ('canonical','description','application/ld+json','Product'))
